body:
Plans, models and the cost of one 5-second clip, side by side.

November 12, 2026. By the Stacy He

For short product and social clips, Pika costs less to start and runs Seedance 2.5 on a $10 plan. On the top plans Runway Max is about 10% cheaper per credit, and Runway is the pick if you want its own Gen models and editing tools.

Pika is an AI video generator and creative suite for video, image and audio. Paid plans start at $10/month (Starter, 600 credits) with Seedance 2.5, Kling 4.0, Veo 3.1 and our own Pika 2.5 and Pika H3 Flex on every plan. Runway's paid plans start at $15/month (Standard, 625 credits) with its own Gen-4.5 plus Kling 4.0, Veo 3.1 and Seedance 2.0; Seedance 2.5 needs Pro at $35. If you want to turn one product photo into a social clip, start in Product Ad .

Prices checked November 12, 2026, on pika.art/pricing and runway.com/pricing .

## Plans compared

Both services take 20% off for annual billing, paid upfront. Plan credits on both do not roll over, except Runway Max, which carries up to one month. Pika top-ups are 60 credits per $1 from $25 and last 365 days; Runway sells extra credits from 1,000 at a time and they never expire.

## Which models each one runs

Pika runs 80+ models, and every model and app is open on every plan. Plans differ only by credits and concurrency.

## What a 5-second clip costs

Credits per generation come from each vendor's published rates at 1080p (Pika H3 Flex at 768p, Veo 3.1 for 8 seconds, images per image). The dollar figures divide the plan price by its monthly credits. Where the two services charge the same credits, the cheaper plan per credit wins: Pika on the entry plans, Runway on the top plans.

## Entry plans: Pika Starter ($10, 600 credits) vs Runway Standard ($15, 625 credits)

## Top plans: Pika Fancy ($95, 8,550 credits) vs Runway Max ($95, 9,500 credits)

Credit costs depend on settings; check the estimate in the app before generating. Runway's Kling 4.0 promotion ends November 30, 2026.

## Where each one is cheaper

• Starting out. On the entry plans Pika is about 30% cheaper per credit, and the same clip costs less on Pika for every model both services run: Kling 4.0 at 1080p is $1.97 against $2.83, Veo 3.1 for 8 seconds is $5.33 against $7.68.

• Seedance 2.5. Pika runs it on every plan, from $10, with the rate on the pricing page. Runway lists it on Pro and Max without a published rate.

• Heavy monthly use. On the top plans Runway Max is about 10% cheaper per credit, so the same Kling, Seedance 2.0 or Veo clip costs a little less there. Pika Fancy still wins on its own models: a Pika H3 Flex draft is 10 credits, about $0.11.

• Drafting. Because every model is on every plan, you can draft on Pika H3 Flex at 10 credits a clip, then render the keeper on Seedance 2.5 or Kling 4.0. On Starter, 600 credits covers about 60 H3 Flex drafts, or four Seedance 2.5 clips at 720p.

## Short product and social clips

For a product ad, the work is mostly the brief: the product, the motion, the format. Product Ad takes a product photo and turns it into a short vertical or square clip, so you do not write a prompt from scratch.

## Image to video

Yes, Pika turns a static product image into an animated clip. Upload the photo, describe the motion, and pick a model. Both services do image to video; the difference is which models you reach on which plan and what each clip costs. On Runway, Seedance 2.5 starts on Pro at $35; on Pika it is on Starter at $10.

Start with a clean, well-lit photo of the product on a plain background. Describe one camera move, not three:

## App demo videos

For an app launch you usually need a few short clips: a hook, a feature moment, a closing frame. Generate each one as a 5-second clip, then cut them together. Pika's apps cover the video, image and audio steps, including Pika Soundtrack for music, so the whole demo stays in one place.

Be honest with yourself about screen content: AI video is good at mood and motion around a device, less reliable at exact UI text. Use your real screen recording for the interface and generated clips around it.

## Where Runway is the better pick

• You want Gen-4.5 or Aleph 2.0. These are Runway's own models and only run there.

• You edit heavily inside the tool. Runway lists Aleph 2.0, Runway Ads and App Studio alongside generation.

• You work on a large team. Runway offers Team and Enterprise plans and publishes data security pages, with Brand Kits and custom voice clones on Pro and Max.

• You generate at volume on one plan. Max at $95 includes 9,500 credits, about 10% more per dollar than Pika Fancy, with one month of rollover.

## Common questions

Is Pika or Runway cheaper for short product videos? It depends on the plan. On the November 12, 2026 list prices, Pika's entry plan costs less ($10 against $15) and the same clip costs less on Pika Starter than on Runway Standard: Kling 4.0 at 1080p is $1.97 against $2.83. On the top plans Runway Max is about 10% cheaper per credit than Pika Fancy. Prices change, so check both pricing pages.

Does Pika add a watermark on the Free plan? No. No Pika plan adds a watermark, including Free. Free has no commercial license; that starts with Starter at $10/month.

Can I use Seedance 2.5 on Pika's cheapest plan? Yes. Every model is on every plan, so Seedance 2.5 runs on Starter. A 5-second 720p clip is 122 credits, about $2.03 on Starter; 1080p is 299 credits.

Does Runway publish a Seedance 2.5 price? Not on its pricing page as of November 12, 2026. Seedance 2.5 appears on Runway's Pro and Max plans without a rate. Pika publishes its Seedance 2.5 rates on pika.art/pricing .

Does Runway run Veo 3.1? Yes, at 320 credits for 8 seconds, the same credit count as Pika. On the entry plans that is $7.68 on Runway Standard against $5.33 on Pika Starter.

Which is better for turning a photo into a social video? Both do image to video. Pick Pika for a lower entry price, Seedance 2.5 from $10 and more third-party models; pick Runway i

نشرت Pika مقارنة بين أسعار خطتها وخطط Runway بتاريخ 12 نوفمبر 2026.

• تبدأ خطط Pika من 10 دولارات شهريًا (600 رصيد) مع Seedance 2.5 وKling 4.0 وVeo 3.1.
• تبدأ خطط Runway من 15 دولارًا (625 رصيدًا) مع Gen-4.5، ويتطلب Seedance 2.5 خطة Pro بسعر 35 دولارًا.
• على الخطط الأساسية تقول Pika إنها أرخص بنحو 30% لكل رصيد، وعلى الخطط العليا تقول إن Runway Max أرخص بنحو 10%.
• خصم 20% عند الدفع السنوي في الخدمتين.

المقارنة صادرة عن Pika نفسها، فينبغي قراءتها بهذا الاعتبار.
